summary.text: Caroline Eason is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 110, facing Democrat Mary Silver in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Eason won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary, defeating incumbent Kelly Hastings, 53.6 percent to 46.4 percent.
